Asha (CS): quick note — Aurelia Health flagged 3 recurring pain points during onboarding this week, plus a small feature ask that might impact renewal timeline. summary below, can we triage?
Jordan (CS): pls paste the notes?
Asha (CS): 1) SDK token rotation docs confusing (multiple customers blocked)
Asha (CS): 2) per-route cost visibility wanted in console (account exec asked)
Asha (CS): 3) default inference timeout too low for long-context prompts -> errors
Asha (CS): feature ask: per-customer model pinning in Dedicated (want stronger isolation)
Miguel (PM): thanks — high level: token docs = docs/quickfix, cost visibility = product/medium, timeout/infra = eng/priority, model pinning = enterprise/priority. agree? :thinking_face:
Priya (Eng): timeout sounds like a runtime config (we can add a per-deployment timeout flag), will need a small schema change. estimate 2 spikes + 1 sprint.
Sam (Solutions): model pinning is a common ask from larger pilots — we should map to Dedicated roadmap and quote SLAs. tagging legal for SSO/KMS concerns.
Jordan (CS): renewal risk on Aurelia is moderate — they’re asking model pinning + billing clarity before Q4 commit. we should surface to AE. @Miguel can you flag in the renewal playbook?
Miguel (PM): will do. Proposed triage: docs fix = P1 (quick), per-route cost = P2 (needs UI), runtime timeout = P1 (ops risk), model pinning = P0 (enterprise sale).
triage-bot: created ticket CS-8249 in product-triage with labels [aurelia,onboarding,renewal-risk]
Asha (CS): thanks bot :raised_hands: — assigning owners: Jordan -> docs contact, Priya -> runtime spike, Miguel -> roadmap + AE sync, Sam -> enterprise scoping.
Priya (Eng): starting a spike today, putting notes in /docs/internal/runtime-timeouts.md. snippet of proposed flag:
Priya (Eng): ```yaml
runtime:
  default_inference_timeout_ms: 60000
  per_deployment_overrides: true
```
Jordan (CS): for docs I’ll draft a short quickstart and a one-pager for AEs. can someone add a sample how-to for token rotation?
Asha (CS): I’ll pull the customer-facing snippets from the call recording and paste them in CS-8249.
Miguel (PM): timeline check — can we have docs + spike notes by next Tue (1777770600)? If yes, we can propose a small PO change for the timeout in the next sprint.
Priya (Eng): yes, spike + PR by then is realistic.
Sam (Solutions): I’ll sketch the enterprise pinning options and rough SOW bullets — will drop into the ticket by EOW.
Asha (CS): great. next step: Jordan to share docs draft, Priya to link spike doc, Miguel to update renewal playbook entry. will sync Fri standup if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
Miguel (PM): adding a one-off metric: tag any reopen related to token docs as "doc-token-rotation" so we can track impact post-fix.
Jordan (CS): noted. thanks team.
